turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I got a note that my liver tests were abnormal.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your ALT is 68 and your AST is 54.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: They are mildly above the normal range.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I do not drink much alcohol.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let us stop the supplement you started and repeat the tests in six weeks.
